_about: Hand-scan fixes (build_reports/hand_scan/fix_plan.csv, 2026-10-18): masked edits run by a2_build/additions_round2/edit_inset.py with GO_EDIT_REGIONS=a2_build/hand_fixes/edit_regions.json. Coordinates in 1536x1024 px, read off the current pictures (the build's first-hit file: out_deck_f62 for A1 keys, out_deck_a2 for A2 keys); poly = unsnapped polygon over the hand, rect = a whole ruled inset (snapped). instruction = the fix_plan sentence adapted to the mask.
